rationale: The short thesis remains intact as DDOG continues to consolidate near the bottom of its intraday range (8.4%), trading well below both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($191.53) and session VWAP ($195.56) on high relative volume (5.86x). Severe relative weakness against a strong broader market (SPY +1.35%) following negative guidance favors holding for a breakdown below session lows.
